objective: cost at the cost-optimal threshold, calibration split
limitations: Tuned on the calibration split, which is also what the isotonic map is fit on — the split does double duty here. A fourth split would be cleaner; at this dataset size it would cost more in variance than it buys in independence.
The objective uses the global FP/FN cost preview, not the per-segment cost matrices of the Day 4 decision layer.
